handbook.what: Turning a trial into a paid school. You pay per teacher seat, and one subscription covers every language and every class those teachers run.
handbook.where: The **Upgrade** button on your dashboard, or Settings then Billing then **Subscribe / choose seats**.
how: Choose Monthly or Annual — annual works out at two months free per seat.
Set the number of teacher seats with the stepper. It opens at the number of teachers who have actually joined.
Tap **Subscribe** and fill in the card details on the payment panel that opens on the page.
You come back to the dashboard with the subscription live.
handbook.note: Seats are teacher seats, not student seats. Your students do not each need one.
